place.name: Embriago Coffee
place.address: 5 Rivington St, New York, NY 10002, USA

reasons.text: I believed Embriago Coffee served the best cappuccino in the neighborhood.
It was the best coffee I had while being in New York.

place.blurb: Thoughtfully curated, sophisticated yet laid-back coffee shop with a speakeasy-inspired ambiance and comfortable seating.
good_to_know: Embriago Coffee offers a spacious seating area for customers.
Credit cards and mobile payments are accepted at Embriago Coffee.

doc_notes: score is the overall Atly score; category_scores are the categories reviewers mention most (up to 40), each with how many reviews mention it and its score where enough do — a category absent here, or with no score, was mentioned too rarely to score. Quote reasons verbatim, and link url if present. hours_updated_at is over a year ago: say the hours may have changed and suggest checking with the place; open_now rests on them.
